name: Survey Tracking-ucc_survey_version
label: UCC Survey Version
description: The frozen question set these responses belong to. survey_name links to Survey Management, which is a planning document and is not versioned - without this link a score cannot be reproduced against the exact questions asked.

name: Survey Tracking-ucc_collection_status
label: Collection Status
description: Live-collection state. Deliberately blank by default so the existing Survey Tracking records, which are post-hoc consolidation rows and never collected anything, are not misread as campaigns.

name: Survey Tracking-ucc_public_token
label: Public Token
description: Generated server-side. A Custom Field cannot generate it - that comes from this app's doc_events hook on Survey Tracking, not from educ_sg.
